facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog post about its LiveRamp integration was published on June 22, 2021.
According to StackAdapt, LiveRamp's Retrieval API gives advertisers in the US direct access to onboard and activate CRM audiences in near real-time.
facts.quote: The API gives advertisers in the US direct access to onboard and activate customer relationship management (CRM) audiences in near real-time.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, a new segment created from uploaded CRM data can be ready in around half an hour after the data is matched to LiveRamp's RampID.
facts.quote: so your new segment can be created in around half an hour.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that CRM data uploaded to its UI can include email address, name, phone number, and postal address.
facts.value: email address, name, phone number, postal address
facts.quote: including email address, name, phone number and postal address—directly into the StackAdapt UI.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, uploaded CRM data is hashed and then matched to LiveRamp's pseudonymous identifier, RampID.
facts.quote: Once uploaded, the data is hashed, and then matched to LiveRamp’s pseudonymous identifier, RampID

facts.fact: StackAdapt says StackAdapt customers do not need a separate LiveRamp account to onboard, manage, and distribute data.
facts.quote: StackAdapt customers don’t need to create a separate LiveRamp account to onboard, manage, and distribute data.
